title: Epigenomic annotations displayed in the Knowledge Portals
bodyHtml:
Epigenomic data are visible at several locations in the Knowledge Portals:

  • via the Variant Sifter tool
  • in the "Globally enriched annotations" table on Phenotype pages (see an example)
  • in the "Global enrichment" table on Tissue pages (see an example)
  • via the Non-Coding Genetic Association Interactive Tool (NC-GAIT)

Epigenomic datasets are initially loaded to the Common Metabolic Diseases Genome Atlas (CMDGA). Data are accessed from AMP-CMD consortium members and other collaborating researchers; publicly available sources; and large resources such as ChIP-Atlas and the Encyclopedia of DNA Elements (ENCODE). Annotations are transferred from CMDGA to the Data Coordinating Center (DCC) and processed using the stratified LD score regression (S-LDSC) method for display on the Knowledge Portals.

More information about epigenomic annotations is available in the Knowledge Portal documentation. 

Would you like to contribute data to CMDGA? Please see this page for a description of the data types and formats that are currently accepted.
